description: SupabaseReviewRepository directly imports and instantiates AnthropicProvider — a concrete AI-provider adapter from a completely unrelated layer — bypassing this codebase's entire ports/adapters composition-root pattern (container.ts) and tightly coupling the persistence layer to a specific AI vendor.

required_findings.justification: This codebase's own composition root (container.ts) is the ONLY place that is supposed to decide which concrete adapter backs a port — every other module depends on port types (ReviewRepository, AIProvider), never a concrete class. Here the persistence adapter directly imports and `new`s up AnthropicProvider itself, and calls its review() method from inside a data-listing method that has nothing to do with AI review. This is inappropriate coupling between two unrelated layers, bypassing dependency injection entirely.

explanation: A concrete, self-contained coupling violation: the whole chain (import, field instantiation, and the out-of-place call) is visible within 9 lines. allowed_categories also accepts the cross-layer-import framing as an equally valid description of the same root cause.
